blocks.goal: Extract the start/end proximity and envelope calculation responsibility while preserving RouteRequest.isCloseToStartOrEnd(Vertex) and the existing location accessors.

ops.details: Move the proximity-specific state and behavior used by isCloseToStartOrEnd(Vertex), including fromEnvelope, toEnvelope, getEnvelope(Coordinate, int), and the calculations using Coordinate, Envelope, and SphericalDistanceLibrary. Keep RouteRequest.from(), setFrom(GenericLocation), to(), setTo(GenericLocation), and the public isCloseToStartOrEnd(Vertex) compatibility method; the latter delegates to the extracted responsibility. RouteRequest will continue to reference GenericLocation and Vertex, but it will no longer directly reference Coordinate, Envelope, or SphericalDistanceLibrary. The target gains one dependency on RouteRequestLocationProximity while eliminating three distinct outgoing dependencies, for an expected net Fan-Out reduction of two.

blocks.goal: Extract path-comparator selection from RouteRequest while preserving getPathComparator(boolean) and the pathComparator configuration field.

ops.details: Move the pathComparator state and the implementation of getPathComparator(boolean), including the selection and construction of DurationComparator and PathComparator, into RouteRequestPathComparator. Retain RouteRequest.getPathComparator(boolean) as a compatibility method that delegates to the extracted responsibility and retain the existing pathComparator field semantics. RouteRequest continues to expose Comparator<GraphPath> and the boolean parameter, but no longer directly references DurationComparator or PathComparator. The target gains one dependency on RouteRequestPathComparator while eliminating two distinct outgoing dependencies, for an expected net Fan-Out reduction of one.
